messages:
support_jordan: Heads up — seeing a surge of customer reports about tool/function call failures. Lots of 400s and some 500s for tool parsing over the last 15m. Dashboard spike around ~13:40 UTC. @sre_li @eng_kyle :rotating_light:

sre_li: I pulled the alert. TP-4821 triggered — ToolParseError rate > 5% aggregated in us-west-2. Looked correlated with tool-adapter pods (pod autoscale kicked).

oncall-bot: [ALERT] TP-4821 Tool parsing error rate exceeded threshold (5m window) — incident created.

eng_kyle: putting this on my queue. can someone paste a sample failing request so I can repro locally?

support_jordan: pasted below from customer-37 (sanitized):
```json
{"model":"gpt-3x","input":"summarize:","tool_call":{"name":"search","args":"q=latency"}}
```
error returned to customer: 400 Bad Request — tool arg validation failed: expected object for 'args' but got string

ml_marta: that payload screams schema mismatch. clients sending args as querystring-like string, adapter expects an object (e.g. {"query":"..."} or {"q":"..."}). we shipped tool-adapter v1.3.2 ~2h ago — can be related.

eng_kyle: confirmed deployment: tool-adapter v1.3.2 rolled 2026-03-15T13:02:11Z. rolling back to v1.3.1 as hotfix.

support_jordan: also seeing some 500s with parse stacktrace from adapter:
```text
ToolParserError: Unexpected token '"' at position 12
    at parse (/app/adapters/tool_parser.js:142)
    at processRequest (/app/adapters/index.js:88)
```
(same request ids: req-98342, req-98347, req-98390)

sre_li: routing change: switching 'search' tool traffic in us-west-2 to legacy-adapter pool (hot fallback) — starting gradual shift 20% -> 100% to reduce customer impact.

eng_kyle: rollback command issued: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/tool-adapter --to-revision=3` — watching rollout status and readiness probes.

ml_marta: I'm also preparing a quick schema-compatibility gate for the tool-adapter CI to catch this class of changes. will open PR with failing test + docs update.

support_jordan: I've messaged the affected customers with an interim note: we saw intermittent parsing errors for tool calls, engineers investigating, ETA 20m. asked for repro payloads and request ids.

sre_li: traffic reroute + rollback reduced error tail. dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboard/alerts/TP-4821 — error rate down from 9.7% -> 0.6% in 10m.

eng_kyle: rollback complete, newly deployed pods show no ToolParserError log entries in the last 5m. marking incident as mitigated but we'll run a postmortem.

ml_marta: follow-ups: (1) patch adapter to accept legacy string args with deprecation warning for one release, (2) add schema validation test to client SDKs and CI, (3) update docs with explicit example shapes for tool args.

support_jordan: I'll close the support escalation tickets once customers confirm. scheduling blameless PM for tomorrow 10:00 PT — owners: eng_kyle, ml_marta, sre_li, support_jordan. Closing this thread for now. :white_check_mark:
